objective: Find out within one execution round whether timing the v1.2 book's 22 slow inputs (or 9 themes) by the sign of their trailing 12-month industry- and beta-neutral long-short return (design section 12 timing layer) raises the offset-median net Sharpe of the paper-bound v1.2 book by >= 0.10 in both the recent and the stress-ML window; a pass leads to a shadow next to M0, a stop closes recency timing of the inputs for this construction.
target_regime_and_horizon: US U3000 equities, weekly 5-tranche market-neutral long-short book (v1.2), holding about one week per tranche; judged on 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 (recent) and 2019-01-02..2023-08-31 (stress-ML). The timing rule is slow (12-month lookback, a few switches a year per input); it is meant to cut inputs whose factor premium has been negative for a year (e.g. the momentum inputs in 2024-2026) and to restore them after a positive year.
existing_solution_comparison: Ehsani-Linnainmaa 2022 (Table 3): time-series winners 1.33 Sharpe vs equal weight 1.06 on up to 20 US factors 1964-2015, gross; the long-short version (0.98) does not beat equal weight. Fan et al. 2022 (Table 9, full text): long-short factor momentum does not beat buy-and-hold and the effect concentrates in about a quarter of factors; they do not test winners-only. NRRZ 2023: past returns and volatility are the best single factor-timing predictors, median gain about 2% a year per factor. No public record applies winners-only timing to the inputs of a composite inside a cost-modelled, hedged weekly book on U3000 over 2019-2026; reuse covers the rule, not the net effect in this construction.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the signal-level gain seen in this repo (signal-level-check.txt: winners-only vs equal-weight inputs, Sharpe 0.68 vs 0.49 stress 2018-10..2023-08 and 1.99 vs 1.81 recent, gross, monthly) survives rank-normalization, industry demeaning, the beta hedge, the VIX rule and costs at the book level, and whether it is timing information rather than reweighting (Markov timing placebo).
negative_experiments_checked: Registry check 'factor momentum' (no equity-book entry; country-ETF momentum watch_recent rows are unrelated). v1.2 M1 (rolling residual-IC weights) lost to M0 (recent net 1.389 vs 1.506): recency weighting on residual IC failed; this contract times total industry/beta-neutral long-short returns with the E-L sign rule instead and keeps the M1 result as a prior-lowering negative. RF1 (10-01) chose a VIX-state variant over a recency tilt from the Fan 2022 abstract without testing it in our data; M0V was not run (data constraint). v1.3 (cost rules) and v1.4 Stage A (ML composites: gains only in the recent window) checked; the signal-level check is disclosed in hypotheses.md section 0.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Unchanged v1.2 / T-25 R6: decision at the close of D, fill at the close of D+1 (closing auction), cost model v1 at the close snapshot (half-spread + square-root impact at E = $1M + 0.5 bp fees), borrow 25 bp a year on short notional, easy-to-borrow shorts only, EWMA SPY hedge, VIX > 20.60 halves; 2x-cost replay reported. Timing switches add turnover on switch dates; measured, not assumed.
stop_condition: Stage A: no candidate beats M0's simplified gross Sharpe in both windows with its Markov timing placebo quantile >= 0.90 on full_ml -> stop, keep M0, close recency timing of the inputs for the v1.2 construction. Stage B: no candidate meets E1 (+0.10 both windows), E2 (>= 4/5 offsets each window), E4 (|beta| <= 0.15) and E5 -> same. Budget: one execution round, local or Modal <= $1.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Stage A of brief T-20261004-04: build g_k(p) from regimes/signal_ls_daily.parquet (labels t <= p-2, 252-label compounded return), the three composites from the signal library with the identity check (g = 1 reproduces m0_composite), simplified weekly gross Sharpe vs M0 over 5 offsets in both windows with the v1.4 Stage A code path, and 20 Markov timing placebos per candidate.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one candidate's offset-median simplified weekly gross Sharpe exceeds M0's in both the recent 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 and the stress-ML 2019-01-02..2023-08-31 window, and its full-ML value is above the 18th highest of its 20 Markov timing placebos.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No candidate beats M0 in both windows with the placebo passed: 12-month factor momentum on the book's inputs adds nothing before costs in this construction, Stage B is not run and recency timing of the inputs is closed for v1.2.

sources.claim: Ehsani and Linnainmaa (JF 77(3) 2022; NBER w25551): most factors are positively autocorrelated; the average factor earns about 1 bp a month after a year of losses and 53 bp after a positive year. Table 3 (up to 20 factors, July 1964 onward, monthly): equal-weighted factors Sharpe 1.06, time-series winners (prior one-year return > 0) 1.33, losers 0.04, long-short time-series factor momentum 0.98, cross-sectional 0.76.
sources.core_claim: Factors are positively autocorrelated at one year; time-series winners Sharpe 1.33 vs equal weight 1.06; long-short factor momentum 0.98.
sources.applicability: Defines the 12-month sign rule and the winners-only form applied to M0's inputs and themes.
sources.independent_replication: Gupta and Kelly (JPM 2019) and Arnott et al. report factor momentum on other factor sets; Fan et al. 2022 dispute the individual-factor strength.
sources.limitations: US factors from 1964 on, gross of costs, factor portfolios rather than composite weights inside one book; our inputs are 22 correlated slow signals over 2017-2026.
sources.market_and_period: US equity factors, July 1964 - 2015 (up to 20 factors), monthly, gross
